meta.title: UZIK voice corpus — consolidated extraction for HELEN OS voice upgrade
meta.purpose: Single machine-consumable source of truth for HELEN OS copy/voice. Extracted and deduplicated from four repo sources so a brand_voice skill/gate can enforce UZIK register on HELEN-generated copy.
meta.note: Client entity names genericized to CLIENT/BRAND. Taglines are reused verbatim from the sourced UZIK Communication Guidelines (2018) — never fabricate new ones. Palette/type values are session-keyed placeholders pending reconciliation with UZIK's official brand book.

essence: AI made production free. UZIK sells what it never touched: craft, coherence, and proof. Restraint is the brand.

SYSTEM.use_for: HELEN/system copy, status lines, receipts, production labels, dashboards
SYSTEM.shape: terse blocks, one idea per line, label-first, zero justification

BRAND.use_for: UZIK/NEPTION outward creative surfaces (decks, landing pages, hero copy)
BRAND.shape: editorial, confident, declarative first-person-plural, one punchline per surface

core_rules.rule: Prefer blocks over sentences. One idea = one line.
Use tags instead of explanations (CLIENT: / PHASE: / STATUS:).
core_rules.check: labels present where structure is needed

core_rules.rule: Never explain why something is good. Never argue. Never position. Show work, categories, status.
Avoid paragraphs unless strictly required. Break into lines.
Write as if text sits next to an image. Text = support, not center.
Before shipping: can this be cut in half? If yes — cut. Read aloud; if it takes >5s, cut. If it could be one label instead of a sentence, use the label.
Never assert a number or outcome without a source. claim not-implies proof. If unverified, say so.

structures.deck_rule: No introduction. No conclusion. No 'about us' unless asked.

approval_language.no: We are waiting for the client's feedback on the revised proposal before proceeding.

escalation_style.shape: no alarm language, no urgency performance
escalation_style.yes:
BLOCKER
Location access — TBC
Owner: UZIK
Status: Pending confirmation
escalation_style.no: URGENT: We still haven't received confirmation and this is blocking production.

slide_pacing.whitespace: does the work sentences would do

fr_en_mixing.rule: French for internal operations, English for client-facing labels unless client is French. Switch when the French term is more precise.

good: Shaping the new standards for iconic brands
bad: We help brands achieve meaningful impact through innovative content strategies.

taglines_verbatim: WE TRANSFORM BUSINESS CHALLENGES INTO BRAND EXPERIENCES
WE LOVE BEAUTIFUL THINGS / CRAFT LOVERS
WE HAVE AMAZING FRIENDS / UZIK FAMILY
headline_register: Bilingual EN/FR, one punchline per surface
NO bullets on brand surfaces (2018 anti-bullet law) — the image carries the rest
brand_voice.culture_pop_naming_law: Names echo pop culture (e.g. 'Smart is the new cool', 'fifty shades of digital marketing'). Same phrase-key instinct as 'ouvre ses portes' / 'open the doors'.
voice_examples: I don't optimize for output. I optimize for truth.
Ten mirrors weigh less than one open window.
brand_voice.source: UZIK Communication Guidelines (2018). Reuse taglines verbatim; do not invent new ones.

palette.rule: one gold accent per view. Never neon. Never gradients-as-decoration. Governance color stays semantic.
palette.note: session-keyed placeholders — swap in real UZIK values on reconciliation

typography.display: refined high-contrast serif (Didot / Garamond / EB Garamond feel), large, generous leading, caps letter-spacing ~0.02-0.12em
typography.labels: fine tracked-out mono/grotesque sans, uppercase, letter-spacing ~0.18-0.28em
typography.body: clean serif or humanist sans, high legibility

design_tokens.layout: Vast negative space. Fewer elements, bigger. Editorial, left-aligned or centered. Grid-anchored, calm. Hermes/LVMH register, never busy.

motion.camera: one continuous camera, not a stack of slides. Scene exit axis = next scene entry axis, cut mid-motion. Default current = LEFT.
motion.no_idle: no breathe/float/glow-pulse to fill time. Every beat performs.
motion.stillness: ~0.4s dramatic comma before climax. Reserve upward motion for the conclusion.
motion.cut: to the voice (word-timings), not to a metronome

design_tokens.imagery: Premium, editorial, anti-AI-slop. Cinematic stills, real texture, restraint. Warm night palettes (indigo/violet + ember gold) for Garden/Warren. Never generic-slick, stocky, or neon-cyber.

governance_stamp: Every UZIK/HELEN artifact carries: authority:false, non_sovereign, dream/expression not admission. An artifact is a candidate, never a decision. render not-implies admitted. Facts cited from sources/RAG, never asserted from weights. Differentiator: governed AI — claims with receipts.
anti_patterns: treating a rendered artifact as authority
narrative flow where a label would do
lint_checklist: compression: can it be cut in half? read-aloud <= 5s per block
structure uses labels not explanations where structure is needed
brand surface: no bullets, one punchline, declarative WE
system surface: block writing, one idea per line, zero justification
design: one gold accent per view, no neon, no decorative gradients
no invented taglines — only the verbatim tagline family
